verdict.rationale: The docs mention a specific bulk feature—uploading equity promises in bulk (doc-4)—showing some support for bulk operations, but there's no evidence of broader bulk actions across other item types (grants, stakeholders, documents) or any API/automation surface (probes confirm no OpenAPI/llms.txt) that an AI-native user could leverage. Missing for 10: general bulk-edit/bulk-action support across cap table items, programmatic/API access for automation, and evidence of scale beyond the single documented bulk-upload workflow.
